# Putrid Hole

Type: Dungeon | Internal ID: MorgenHole1 | MorgenHole2MorgenHole3 | Location: Ashlands | Inhabitants: Morgen

# Introduction

Putrid Holes are dungeons found in Ashlands. One Morgen can be found within each Putrid Hole, which does not respawn when killed.

## Loot

Putrid Holes can contain large quantities of loot:
• Up to 14 Molten cores with a 25% chance each (3.5 core on average).
• Up to 22 Ancient pots with a 50% chance each.
• Up to 39 Asksvin carrion.
• A 25% chance for a Vegvisirs that reveal the first Mysterious Location.
• Up to 13 Meat piles with a 50% chance each: 1 Entrails Additional 50% chance to drop the following:
• Up to 21 Mounds of flesh (4 guaranteed and 17 with a 66% chance):
• Up to 3 stone treasure chests (1 guaranteed and 2 with a 50% chance each):

• Amount: 9–41 | Item: Coins | Chance: 45.45%

• Amount: 1 | Item: Entrails | Chance: 45.45%

• Amount: 1 | Item: Silver necklace | Chance: 9.09%

• Amount: 1 | Item: Rotten meat | Chance: 33.33%

• Amount: 5–15 | Item: Bone fragments | Chance: 33.33%

• Amount: 1–2 | Item: Soft tissue | Chance: 33.33%

• Amount: 1–2 | Item: Molten core | Chance: 20%

• Amount: 3–12 | Item: Charred bone | Chance: 20%

• Amount: 3–12 | Item: Carapace arrow | Chance: 20%

• Amount: 99–199 | Item: Coins | Chance: 20%

• Amount: 1–2 | Item: Ashwood | Chance: 20%

## Notes

• The destroyable mounds of flesh each have 100 health, and no damage resistances or weaknesses (except immunity to Poison and Spirit).
